summary: Iteration 4 (SPARK GeoJSON layer system + Carto keyed basemap + AI copilot chat history) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (8/8) and Playwright UI flow all pass. Built-in layers, upload/create/serve/delete, Malay categorized land-use legend, transparency slider, Carto keyed basemap (no watermark), and chat-history persistence across navigation all verified against the real backend and live Claude streaming.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 778 lines and mixes auth/geo/ai/citizen concerns — consider splitting into routers (routers/geo.py, routers/ai.py, routers/citizen.py) for maintainability.

GET /api/geo/data/{id} accepts JWT via query-string ?auth=... (needed for Leaflet tile-style fetches). Token can end up in server access logs — acceptable trade-off but worth signing a short-lived scoped token or using a per-layer signed URL if this hardens later.

_seed_geo_layers upserts on every startup; harmless but overwrites any manual style tweaks to built-ins across restarts (by design here — call this out if planners are expected to customise built-in styles).
seed_data_creation: Created and immediately deleted TEST_UI_Layer / TEST_upload_layer during tests; no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 focused on GeoJSON layer system (Parts 1,2,4) + copilot chat history (Part 3). Do not re-test citizen wallet/calculator/report or planner simulator/forecast/sites/logistics. Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_geo_and_history.py (module-scoped planner token fixture; loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env if not in shell env). Land-use geojson (~8MB, 12 dissolved multipolygons) takes ~3-6s to first render — allow generous waits when toggling builtin-landuse. Copilot streaming reply completes within ~15s for short prompts; history GET is idempotent.

verification_details.add_layer_flow: upload tiny FeatureCollection → auto-detected attribute=score, mode=graduated → save → layer-delete-<id> appears; builtins have no delete button
verification_details.chat_history: Prompt persists after nav-02→nav-03 round trip; New Chat clears state and starts fresh session
